verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing claims 70+ HRIS integrations that keep large volumes of data accurate, plus custom-field syncing "in one click" (ledgy-docs-9, ledgy-docs-31). That establishes a first-party HRIS sync capability, but the evidence never says how stakeholder records, new hires or terminations flow into equity data, or whether the sync is automatic. Missing for 10: named support for Gusto/Rippling or other specific HRIS/payroll systems, documented automatic propagation of new hires and terminations into equity records, sync frequency/mechanics docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
